Ally protects the opposite side. Many SOLDIERS remain visible around them at different depths, clearly maintaining the encirclement. One SOLDIER moves toward Riven. Riven blocks the attack and forces him backward. Another SOLDIER approaches Ally from the opposite direction. Ally defends himself. Riven and Ally remain close together and protect each other's blind sides. Riven is visibly exhausted. Her breathing is heavy. Her movements are still skilled, but she is becoming slower. The archer is already preparing to fire. Show the archer clearly aiming his bow at Riven. From the archer's position, Riven is visible farther ahead inside the encirclement. Riven is clearly the person in his line of aim. The bow is visibly pointed directly toward Riven. Riven is busy fighting a SOLDIER and is looking away from the archer. Ally looks across the battlefield and notices the arrow already flying toward Riven. He immediately realizes that Riven has not seen it. Ally urgently shouts: "RIVEN!" Riven hears his voice and begins to turn, but she still has not seen the arrow. Ally reacts immediately. He throws himself across Riven's exposed side and places his own body between Riven and the incoming arrow. The same arrow that was fired toward Riven strikes Ally instead. Riven is not hit. Ally immediately loses his strength. Riven catches him as he collapses. Shot 3 — ALLY'S LAST MOMENT Stay close to Riven and Ally. Keep the camera calm. Do not introduce unnecessary action or camera changes. Riven supports Ally and lowers with him toward the ground. The surrounding SOLDIERS become visually secondary. The emotional focus is now entirely on Riven and Ally. Riven holds Ally in her arms. She looks at him in shock. She understands that he deliberately took the arrow meant for her. Riven quietly asks: "Why?" Ally looks at her weakly. He answers: "You would've done the same." A brief silence. Ally loses his remaining strength. His body becomes still. Riven realizes he is gone. She continues holding him. She does not immediately move. Her expression is devastated. Shot 4 — THE DISTANT FIRE While Riven is still holding Ally, something far across the valley catches her attention. Riven slowly raises her head. She looks toward the distant horizon. Follow her gaze across the mountain valley. Far away, in the direction of Riven's home village, several enormous columns of thick dark smoke rise into the late-sunset sky. A distant orange fire glow burns beneath the smoke. Keep the village very far away. Do not move into the village. Do not show detailed destruction yet. Only establish that a major fire is burning in the direction of Riven's home. Return the emotional focus to Riven. She stares at the distant smoke. Her grief is joined by sudden fear. She understands that something terrible is happening at home. But Riven does NOT run away. She does NOT stand up and leave Ally. After looking at the distant fire, Riven slowly lowers her gaze. She looks back down at Ally in her arms. Her expression remains deeply grief-stricken. She stays with him for one final quiet moment. Then Riven slowly and carefully lowers Ally's body onto the ground. She supports his head and shoulders and lays him down gently. Riven remains kneeling beside Ally. She has not left him yet. End on this quiet emotional moment. CUT.
